tools.name: get_tokens
tools.description: List/search tokens from the public Limitless API, including pending tokens. Pagination is upstream pagination; status is not proof of tradeability.

tools.name: get_trending
tools.description: Return the public Limitless discovery feed sorted by its upstream trending score. Pending tokens may appear.

tools.name: get_token_detail
tools.description: Read indexed metadata, status, prices and available statistics for a Solana mint.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Get SOL/USD and indexed token prices for up to 20 mints. These are display prices, not executable quotes; missing token prices are explicit.

tools.name: get_portfolio
tools.description: Read the public indexed portfolio for a Solana wallet. This is the API holdings view; it may omit assets or lag chain state. No auth or wallet ownership is requested.

tools.name: get_trade_quote
tools.description: Quote a buy or sell on an existing Solana mainnet Limitless bonding curve from current on-chain reserves and fees. No signing or submission. Unsupported pending, completed/AMM and EVM trades return errors.

tools.name: build_unsigned_trade
tools.description: Build a fresh Solana mainnet v0 transaction and quote for a Limitless bonding-curve buy/sell. Every signature is zero. The caller must independently validate, simulate, sign and broadcast. No keys accepted. Network fees and possible account/escrow rent are extra.

tools.name: list_listing_targets
tools.description: Read the shared Get listed catalog: supported destinations, manual requirements and paid options. Listing availability is independent of trading. No payment or submission.

tools.name: get_listing_status
tools.description: Read public token listing discovery. To access creator request receipts, provide wallet; without proof, returns an unsigned message to sign locally. Repeat with issuedAt and signature. The same website backend verifies creator ownership.

tools.name: submit_listing
tools.description: Prepare or dispatch supported listing requests through the website’s shared Get listed backend. Requires proof from the token creator. Omit signature and issuedAt to get the exact message to sign locally, then repeat with both. Manual forms remain action_required; paid targets remain payment_require

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_trending, get_listing_status, submit_listing · Private data: get_tokens, get_trending, get_token_detail, get_prices, get_portfolio, get_listing_status, submit_listing · Public sink: build_unsigned_trade, submit_listing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_trending, get_listing_status, submit_listing · Private data: get_tokens, get_trending, get_token_detail, get_prices, get_portfolio, get_listing_status, submit_listing · Public sink: build_unsigned_trade, submit_listing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
